moves.name: Lizard Lunge
moves.description: Low lunge with both hands inside the front foot and the back leg straight.

moves.name: Lunge With Reach
moves.description: From the lizard lunge, rotate and reach the arm on the front-leg side to the sky.

moves.name: Half Splits
moves.description: From the lunge, shift hips back, straighten the front leg and fold over it.

moves.name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
moves.description: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees, one leg in front and one to the side, and lean over the front shin.

moves.name: Plank
moves.description: Forearms on the floor, body in a straight line from head to heels, and hold.

moves.name: Side Plank
moves.description: On one forearm with hips lifted so the body is in a straight line, and hold.

moves.name: Superman Hold
moves.description: Face down, lift arms, chest and legs off the floor, and hold.

moves.name: Single-Arm Single-Leg Superman
moves.description: Face down, reach one arm forward and hold the opposite leg lifted behind you.

moves.name: Seated Straddle Toe Touch
moves.description: Sit with legs apart at 90 degrees and reach towards the toes of one foot.

moves.name: Butterfly Stretch
moves.description: Sit with the soles of both feet together, knees out, and lean forward.

moves.name: Supine Spinal Twist
moves.description: On your back with arms out, drop both knees to one side and look the other way.

moves.name: Squats
moves.description: Feet shoulder-width apart, sit hips back and down with chest up, then stand.

moves.name: Push-Ups
moves.description: Hands under shoulders, body straight, lower chest to the floor and press back up.

moves.name: Reverse Lunges
moves.description: Step one foot back, lower the back knee towards the floor, then drive back to standing.

moves.name: Dead Bugs
moves.description: On your back with arms up and knees bent, lower the opposite arm and leg slowly, keeping your back flat.

moves.name: Glute Bridges
moves.description: On your back with knees bent, drive hips up, squeeze glutes, then lower.

moves.name: Split Squats
moves.description: Back foot on a chair, lower the back knee towards the floor, then stand.

moves.name: Chair Dips
moves.description: Hands on a chair behind you, bend elbows to lower hips, then press back up.

moves.name: Wall Sit
moves.description: Back against a wall, thighs parallel to the floor, and hold.

moves.name: Single-Leg Glute Bridges
moves.description: Glute bridge with one leg extended, driving up through the planted foot.

moves.name: Pike Push-Ups
moves.description: Hips high in an inverted V, bend elbows to lower your head towards the floor, then press up.

moves.name: Jumping Jacks
moves.description: Jump feet wide while raising arms overhead, then jump back together.

moves.name: Mountain Climbers
moves.description: In a high plank, drive knees to the chest alternately and quickly.

moves.name: Squat Jumps
moves.description: Squat down, then jump up and land softly.

moves.name: High Knees
moves.description: Run on the spot, driving knees up to hip height.

moves.name: Burpees
moves.description: Squat, kick feet back to a plank, jump feet in, then jump up.
